title: Mitutoyo 50-75mm Metric Outside Micrometer with Ratchet Stop and Enamel Finish
old_description:
Description

The Mitutoyo 50-75mm Metric Outside Micrometer is an essential precision measuring tool designed for professionals who require accurate and consistent measurements. Its metric scale offers a reliable range from 50 to 75 millimeters, making it suitable for various industrial and mechanical applications. The micrometer's ratchet stop ensures consistent pressure is applied for each measurement, improving accuracy and repeatability.

Crafted with a durable enamel finish, this outside micrometer resists wear and tear, maintaining its quality over time. Its ergonomic design provides comfortable handling during use, allowing you to work efficiently and with confidence. Whether you are in manufacturing, engineering, or quality control, the Mitutoyo micrometer is built to meet your precise gauging needs.

Details

  • Product Material: Metal with enamel finish
  • Manufacturer: Mitutoyo

Features

  • Metric measurement range from 50 to 75 millimeters for versatile use
  • Ratchet stop mechanism ensures consistent measuring pressure for accuracy
  • Durable enamel finish resists wear and extends tool lifespan
  • Ergonomic design for comfortable handling during extended use

How to use

To use the Mitutoyo 50-75mm Metric Outside Micrometer, first ensure the measuring faces are clean. Rotate the thimble to open the spindle, place the object to be measured between the anvil and spindle, then rotate the thimble until the ratchet clicks to apply consistent pressure. Read the measurement from the scale on the sleeve and thimble. Handle the micrometer carefully to avoid dropping or impacts that could affect calibration.

Care instructions

Keep the micrometer clean and free from dust by wiping it with a soft cloth after use. Avoid exposure to moisture or corrosive substances to prevent rusting. Store the micrometer in its protective case when not in use and avoid extreme temperatures. Periodically check calibration to ensure measurement accuracy.
